parameters.name: PolicyId
parameters.description: The ID of the mitigation policy that you want to modify. You can specify only one ID.

parameters.name: PolicyName
parameters.description:
The new name of the mitigation policy.

> You must specify this parameter or PolicyStatus.

parameters.name: PolicyStatus
parameters.description:
The new status of the mitigation policy. Valid values:

- **on**: Enabled.
- **off**: Disabled.

> You must specify this parameter or PolicyName.
